relation: same features, models, metrics and evidence rule as v3; replaces the closing-dated Teranet target with deal-dated TRREB MLS HPI to measure lead without the registration lag. v2 and v3 stay reported.
design: pseudo real-time: first-release monthly HPI levels from each report; publication lag as v3
decision_time: end of calendar month T, America/Toronto

target.series: TRREB MLS HPI composite index, All TRREB Areas, from data/research/trreb-history.csv (2012-02 onward; 2022-05 missing)
target.origin: T-1 (TRREB month M known at end of M+1)
target.rebasing: a window is excluded when it spans a level break; breaks found before results by 12 consecutive months where level-based YoY differs from published YoY by > 1.5 pp: between 2022-04 and 2022-06, and between 2025-03 and 2025-04. Segments: 2012-02..2022-04, 2022-06..2025-03, 2025-04 onward

features: v3 TRREB features at T-1 (moi_yoy, moi_vs_norm, snlr_yoy, snlr_vs_norm, sp_lp_yoy, dom_yoy)

models.benchmark: historical mean of matured targets known at T

evidence_rule: OOS R2 > 0 over the full OOS period and in both subperiods, and Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 over the full OOS period
power_note: short sample (about 8 years out of sample, many overlapping windows); a null result here is weak evidence of no lead
not_allowed: changing features, lags, segments, sample splits or the evidence rule after seeing results
adoption: research evidence only; no dashboard signal
